semiconductor_relevance: High — Semics Inc. specializes in wafer prober equipment essential for testing semiconductor performance, holding a leading position in this niche.
summary: Semics Inc. is a South Korean company that designs and manufactures advanced wafer prober equipment used for testing semiconductor performance. With a focus on accuracy and temperature stability, their products enhance the efficiency and quality of the semiconductor testing process, contributing significantly to yield improvement in fabrication.
capabilities: Wafer prober equipment for 8-inch and 12-inch wafer testing
Advanced die-level probers for logic testing

regional_presence.Korea: Founded in South Korea, Semics has established itself as a key player in the semiconductor testing equipment market.
